verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe fetched a machine-readable OpenAPI document at https://grafana.com/api/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key), which delivers the story's single requirement: a downloadable API spec. Evidence is limited to that one probe; no first-party docs describe the spec, and it is unclear which API surface it covers. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing and linking the OpenAPI spec, confirmation that it covers the Grafana instance HTTP API (not only the grafana.com API), independent or community corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
